title: tc-version-history
description:
The versions of an agent, prompt or workflow on a timeline – draft, active or deprecated, who and when, and what
each changed in behaviour – with compare, restore and a confirmed approve-and-activate.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

description.description: The quiet line under the heading

selected.description: The version whose detail shows; unset follows the draft, else the active version, else the newest

activateBlocked.description: Why the draft can't be activated by this person; set, Approve and activate stays unavailable and says so

canRestore.description: Restore is offered on past versions (default true)

maxHeight.description: The tallest the timeline grows, in px, before it scrolls

statusLabels.description: The names of the statuses – in place of Draft, Active and Deprecated

changeLabels.description: What screen readers hear before each change – in place of Added, Removed and Changed

activateLabel.description: The approve button and the confirmation's action

note.description: One line on what this version is, e.g. "Tightened the review step"

changes.description: What it does differently from the version before it

VersionEntry.description: One version of an agent, prompt or workflow

VersionChange.description: One change, said as what it will do differently: "Asks for approval before sending"

VersionChangeKind.description: What a change did to the behaviour
